data.name: 4th Dawn
data.detailed_description:
"The apocalypse is always tomorrow and never today."

4th Dawn is a story driven game set in a cyberpunk megacity three days before its inevitable destruction. You control Aurion, a rundown streetkid freshly emerged from four years of isolation trying to make his way back into broader society just before it all falls apart.

What he doesn't know yet is he's trapped in a time loop.

Card Based Character Creation

Each of your personality traits are encapsulated through cards, remnants of your past lives codified as tools to be applied to the situations you now find yourself in. Scavenge for spare parts, investigate for information, use your experiences to take every advantage you can. 

Explore a Vast Cyberpunk Dystopia

Enter the City, a giant megastructure stretching upward layer by layer. From the putrid wasteland of the beach all the way up to the surveillance capital of The Complex, each of the game's four locations are constantly filled with people to meet, deals to make, and problems to resolve.

Your Choices Matter: Time Moves Without You

The world is always moving, with or without you. Every choice you make moves time forward, pushing the story forward as characters act in the background. Watch as each decision you make ripples through the complex web of character relationships and connected events.

Try Again, And Again, And Again, And Again...

Every time the world ends, you find yourself right back at the start. Choose different paths, make different choices, and select different cards to explore different outcomes and push the limits of your influence over the world. Discover dozens of hidden endings, each with multiple ways to achieve them. Each discovery unlocks new cards to change your character and find new paths.

data.short_description: A cyberpunk interactive narrative about finding purpose before the end of the world. Experience the last three days over and over, each attempt from new perspectives as you find your story in an infinite pre-apocalypse.
